title.en: An Act to Exempt Awards Given by the Ramon Magsaysay Award Foundation from the Payment of Income, Gift and All Other Taxes
title.orig: An Act to Exempt Awards Given by the Ramon Magsaysay Award Foundation from the Payment of Income, Gift and All Other Taxes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1958/ra_2062_1958.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The provisions of any existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, all awards given by the Ramon Magsaysay Award Foundation shall be exempted from the payment of income, gift and all other taxes.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 13, 1958.
